common_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 2D cutout rigging equipment sprite sheet for the existing golden chihuahua character. The attached reference character_base.png is the exact anatomy and layout template, NOT merely style inspiration.
Create ONE new Holy / sacred equipment class variant. Exactly SEVEN detached components only, in exactly the reference positions: weapon upper left; head upper right; separate torso center right; two separate arms lower left; two separate legs with shoes bottom right. Do not assemble a character.
Output a PNG with actual transparent background. Preserve the source canvas aspect 1155:1362, preferably exactly 1155x1362. No text, grid, labels, floor, shadow, decorative stars, floating particles or extra parts.
Anatomy is locked: identical chihuahua face, ear size, eye placement, muzzle, expression and 3/4 view; identical head size. Do not enlarge the head or ears. Keep hat within the existing head/ear silhouette, no tall crown. Keep the bare golden arm and leg connector shafts EXACTLY as drawn: same lengths, widths, curves, angles, top endpoints and positions. Only dress the hands and feet BELOW the original cuffs. Left hand remains open, right hand remains clenched. Two feet point right. All parts remain separated by transparent empty space.
At 1155x1362: head bounds roughly x497..946 y85..461; torso x578..871 y562..906; arm1 x86..198 y908..1192; arm2 x336..448 y986..1252; leg1 x569..741 y1069..1320; leg2 x860..1032 y1070..1321. Keep these proportions and locations. Weapon points northwest to southeast with handle end near x350 y403.
CRITICAL TORSO RULE: the torso is ONLY the simple narrow sleeveless vest-shaped central trunk, contained within reference torso outline, rounded bottom. No sleeves at all, no shoulder pads, no shoulder projections, no attached arms or hands, no back ornaments, no wings, no cape, no cloak, no tails, no banners. Ornament must be flat decoration INSIDE the trunk silhouette. Do not give the torso a neck, head or shoulder stubs. Headwear cannot trail down behind torso.
Art style: match reference precisely, bold clean near-black outlines, smooth polished cel shading, warm golden fur, readable hand-painted cartoon mobile-game equipment. Holy identity through pearl ivory, luminous pale gold metal and a small inset gem and engraved sacred medallion. NO wings or feather shapes even as accessories. All lighting and radiance stay inside solid material; NO outer aura or bloom.
